results.title: The Human-Centered Design Behind AI Clinicians Can Trust
results.caption: Designing AI that people can understand, trust, and use through human-centered design.
results.anchorTitle: Why trust is the real rate-limiting step
results.blurb: Explores why trust is the rate-limiting step in AI adoption and presents four design principles for building trustworthy AI co-pilots that clinicians can understand and rely on.

results.title: Evidence-based AI answer engine for Clinicians
results.caption: GoInvo helped Guidelines.com turn twenty years of clinical expertise into a clear AI product strategy and interactive prototypes in four weeks, with clinical trust designed into every answer.
results.anchorTitle: The trust model came before the interface.
results.blurb: Case study on designing an AI answer engine where clinical trust was built into the product strategy before the interface—demonstrating how evidence systems and source transparency earn clinician confidence.

results.title: A Design Diagnostic for Clinical Software
results.caption: The design failures that cause clinical software abandonment, patient harm, and reputational damage are almost always visible before launch. GoInvo's design diagnostic surfaces them and puts the evidence in front of the people who decide whether to ship.
results.blurb: Published diagnostic framework that surfaces design failures in clinical software before launch, with explicit attention to the AI trust problem and why credibility is a design challenge.

clinicians don't trust our ai's suggesti.insight: You need to understand how to design AI recommendations that clinicians will actually trust and adopt.

results.title: Closing the SNAP Gap
results.caption: A 50% increase in digital applications means more people are getting the food they need.
results.blurb: Redesigned the digital application process for SNAP benefits in Massachusetts, resulting in a 50% increase in digital applications so more people could access the food they need. Directly addresses the challenge of simplifying public benefits access.

results.title: Transforming Service Access in Massachusetts
results.caption: A centralized MA resident database for better service accessibility.
results.anchorTitle: Challenges of Accessing Services in Massachusetts
results.blurb: Published concept for a centralized Massachusetts resident database designed to improve accessibility to state services by reducing fragmentation and complexity in eligibility determination across multiple programs.

results.title: Designing for the Public Sector
results.caption: How design helps the public sector address challenges and increase resident engagement and accessibility.
results.anchorTitle: Core principles for public sector design
results.blurb: Framework for applying design to public sector challenges to increase resident engagement and accessibility. Covers core principles relevant to streamlining how citizens interact with government services.

applying for public benefits is too hard.insight: Visitor is seeking design solutions that simplify public benefits application and enrollment processes.

results.title: The Future of Research Intelligence
results.caption: Designing an AI-powered platform that transforms siloed data into actionable insights using deep research and advanced models.
results.blurb: Designed an AI-powered platform that transforms siloed data into actionable insights using deep research and advanced models. Addresses the core challenge of extracting answers from fragmented research data.

results.title: From 15 Disconnected Tools to One
results.caption: Designing a unified research operations platform that replaced 15 disconnected tools across Ipsos's global workflow — reducing friction, standardizing data, and giving teams a single source of truth.
results.blurb: Unified 15 disconnected research tools into a single platform, standardizing data and creating a single source of truth across global research operations. Solves fragmentation that obscures research findings.

results.title: CDS Repository for Standards of Care
results.caption: Design a national repository for providers, developers, and researchers to disseminate and use implementable clinical decision support tools.
results.blurb: Designed a national repository for providers, developers, and researchers to disseminate and use implementable clinical decision support tools, making research-backed standards accessible and actionable.

we can't find answers in decades of rese.insight: Visitor is seeking solutions to locate, access, or synthesize research findings that are currently lost or inaccessible within large datasets or fragmented systems.

results.title: Health Data Basics
results.caption: Open source designs, and assets to educate patients on health data.
results.blurb: Open source designs and educational assets to help patients understand health data. Directly addresses patient comprehension of their own health information.

results.title: hGraph
results.caption: Your health in one picture.
results.blurb: A visual system designed to represent health in a single, coherent picture. Tackles the challenge of making complex health data legible and meaningful to patients.

results.title: Vaccination Cards for the Nation
results.caption: Helping patients to access and use their health data and vaccination credentials through CommonHealth, an open source health record.
results.blurb: Helps patients access and use their health data through an open source health record interface. Focuses on making vaccination credentials and health information usable by patients.

results.title: Who Uses My Health Data?
results.caption: The health data trade has quietly grown with little patient or doctor knowledge.
results.anchorTitle: Patients need Insight, Control, and Ownership
results.blurb: Explores patient insight and control over health data in a healthcare system where data flows quietly without patient awareness. Related research on why patient data literacy and ownership matter.

patients can't make sense of their healt.insight: Visitor is seeking design solutions that help patients interpret and understand their own health data.
